annotations.title: Add a person to the company

description: Invite a person to the company by email, with their name, title and phone for their signature. They get an email with the invitation and their signature. Counts toward the company plan's people limit. Company owners only. For someone already in the company, use update_member_field; to send an invitation again, use resend_invite.

company.description: The company slug (as in its Signatoro URL) or its id.
